verdict.rationale: Productboard associates feedback with users/companies and offers a searchable feedback repository plus auto-detected insight linking, which supports surfacing customer context alongside feedback for prioritization (docs-4, docs-14, docs-15, docs-16). However, there's no concrete evidence of a dedicated customer-context dashboard, segmentation, or analytics view combining customer attributes (e.g., ARR, tier) with feedback volume for prioritization decisions. missing for 10: evidence of customer segmentation/enrichment in prioritization views, independent user validation of this workflow, and detail on how customer context is visually surfaced during prioritization.
